# This repository's own guard: extended regexes matched against file paths in edit/create/view
# tool arguments. "write:" blocks only writes; otherwise reads are blocked too.

# Secrets: never read or write
(^|/)\.env(\..*)?$
id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.pem$|\.p12$|\.pfx$
(^|/)\.ssh/
\.aws/credentials
(^|/)\.(npmrc|pypirc|netrc|git-credentials)$

# This repo's harness, its CI and its license: humans change these.
# (The template's own files under template/ stay editable; that is the work.)
write:^\.github/hooks/
write:^\.github/workflows/
write:^\.claude/settings\.json$
write:^CLAUDE\.md$
write:^LICENSE$
write:\.agent-logs/
write:\.git/
